Senses.Explanation: A word or half a phrase is a deliberately small verbal opening: in these records it may give an entrant a place to enter, expose what years of residence have not resolved, or strike with the force of an implement. Fayan says the ancients lower it to give people an entry; Dahui contrasts immediate recognition through it with decades without a landing; Yuanwu refuses to treat it as a lifetime possession and instead tests what such speech does when it is uttered.
